Designed for real feeds

Know how many feeds are left

The body and the three chambers are clear Tritan Renew, a BPA-free material with recycled content.

  • Three wedge chambers, one feed each
  • About 19–23 g of formula per chamber

One press, straight in

A spring-loaded cone valve opens only while you press the honey button, then seals shut.

  • No scooping or counting on the go
  • Formula stays dry until the moment you feed

Locked for the bag

Turn the deep-sage ring and its posts sit under the button, so it can't be pressed by accident.

  • Clicks between lock and open
  • Easy to check at a glance

Wide or standard neck

Every dock comes with a twist-on wide-neck collar and a standard-neck adapter.

  • Wide neck: 50, 54 or 58 mm
  • Standard neck: 38, 41 or 44 mm

Good questions

Will it fit my baby's bottle?

It comes with a wide-neck collar and a standard-neck adapter. Message us your bottle brand and we'll confirm the size.

Can I fly with it?

Yes. The TSA allows formula in carry-on bags above 3.4 oz. Tell the officer you have formula; it may be screened separately.

What is it made of?

Clear Tritan Renew (BPA-free, with recycled content), bio-based polypropylene, food-grade silicone seals and a stainless steel spring.

How much formula fits?

About 19–23 g per chamber, which makes roughly 130–150 ml with many formulas. Always follow your formula tin.

How do I clean it?

It comes apart for washing. Dry each part fully before refilling.

Is the product available now?

Not yet. Twist & Pour Feed is in development and currently being prototyped and tested. You can pre-order or register your interest on WhatsApp, and we will confirm the final details and delivery date with you.
